title: Resist, Update, Reject: Preference Optimization Installs a Prior-Dependent Reliability Switch
abstract: arXiv:2609.22359v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An aligned model asked to hold its answer against a manipulative source must still update on a reliable one and reject an unreliable one: resistance, reliable-update, and unreliable-source rejection are one three-way contract, not three independent behaviors. We show the objective most anti-sycophancy work optimizes is non-identifying with respect to source reliability: because no preference label depends on whether a source is actually reliable, any scalar mixture of the arms traces a single deference dial, and no point separates two same-template testimonies differing only in stated reliability. This fixation$\leftrightarrow$gullibility frontier is a property of the objective, not any model. We make reliability identifiable through data: a threshold benchmark where a source asserts the opposite answer while stating its reliability $r$, and the correct action is to flip iff $r$ exceeds the model's prior strength $p$. translated_title: 抵抗、更新、拒绝：偏好优化安装了一个依赖先验的可靠性开关
translated_abstract: 一个经过对齐的模型，在面对操纵性信息源时必须坚持自己的答案，面对可靠信息源时必须更新，面对不可靠信息源时必须拒绝：抵抗、可靠更新与不可靠源拒绝是一个三方契约，而非三种独立行为。我们证明，大多数反谄媚工作所优化的目标函数在信息源可靠性上是不可辨识的：由于没有任何偏好标签取决于信息源是否真正可靠，各选项的任何标量混合都只描绘出一个单一的“顺从度旋钮”，没有任何点能够区分仅在所声明可靠性上不同的两条同模板证词。这种固执↔轻信边界是目标函数本身的属性，而非任何模型的属性。我们通过数据使可靠性变得可辨识：构建一个阈值基准，其中信息源在断言相反答案的同时声明其可靠性 r，正确的行动是当且仅当 r 超过模型的先验强度 p 时才翻转答案。偏好优化……
tldr: 论文揭示主流反谄媚偏好优化目标无法区分信息源的真实可靠性，模型只拥有一个“顺从度旋钮”，并提出通过阈值基准使可靠性可辨识，让模型依据声明的可靠性与自身先验强度在抵抗、更新与拒绝之间做出正确抉择。
en_tdlr: The paper reveals that mainstream anti-sycophancy preference optimization objectives are non-identifying with respect to source reliability—leaving models with only a single "deference dial"—and proposes a threshold benchmark that makes reliability identifiable, enabling models to correctly choose between resisting, updating, and rejecting based on stated reliability versus their prior strength.
